text: Allwyn AG, listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (ATHEX: ALWN), completed its business combination with OPAP on 24 March 2026; apart from a free float of 22%, its shares are held indirectly by KKCG. OPAP's investor pages list KKCG as strategic shareholder, with a free float of 21% excluding treasury shares, as of April 2026.
short: KKCG holds most of Allwyn, which is listed in Athens (ALWN).

source.name: Allwyn: Allwyn completes landmark business combination, creating the second-largest listed lottery and gaming operator globally
source.quote: Of these, 166,406,223 shares will constitute the free float (representing 22%), with the remaining shares continuing to be held indirectly by the investment firm, KKCG.

additionalSources.name: OPAP investor relations: Allwyn AG Shareholder Structure
additionalSources.quote: Allwyn’s shareholder structure as of April 1st, 2026, consists of KKCG as strategic shareholder and free float representing 21% (excluding treasury shares)
